comment: Patterns that must never appear in the public site (plan 4.10, 5.4/5). Python `re` syntax, matched case-insensitively. `secrets` also apply to every wiki Markdown file (the tool's check reads this file); `machine_paths` and `output_only` apply only to rendered output, because the Markdown legitimately holds these in HTML comments that the renderer drops (and a URL may contain such a path segment). The last output_only rule: no link or image may point into sources/ or references/ (those files are strictly private).
